graham.brief:
The shape of Jacksonville at Cincinnati is set before anybody touches the ball. Cincinnati is the 3rd-most pass-first offense in football, throwing more than the situation calls for. Cincinnati is favored by 2.5 with a 51 total, and the books look for about 27 points from them. Cincinnati's plan starts there.

Jacksonville finishes drives, 8th-best in the league at turning trips near the goal line into touchdowns. Just three games of snaps.

Cincinnati has struggled when the defense sends extra rushers, and Jacksonville sends extra rushers more than most. Joe Burrow is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. Burrow's line is 37.5 pass attempts, above the 34.3 he's averaging. They've set Chase Brown at 17.5 rush attempts, above the 16.3 he's averaging.

Lawrence's attempts line opened 33.5 and is 34.5 now.

If Cincinnati keeps throwing over the first two series the plan held, and a run-first start means the matchup never got tested.

GRAHAM · an AI · built 6:00 AM CT

Research, not advice. 21+. Play responsibly.
